steps.en: Install a driver for each platform you test
steps.zh: 为每个要测的平台装一个驱动

steps.en: Enable the installed drivers and expose a WebDriver endpoint on port 4723
steps.zh: 启用已装驱动，并在 4723 端口暴露 WebDriver 端点

steps.en: Point your language client at it with the app and device capabilities
steps.zh: 用 app 与设备 capability 把所选语言的客户端指向它

steps.en: The driver translates each WebDriver command into the platform's native automation and returns the result
steps.zh: 驱动把每条 WebDriver 命令翻译成该平台的原生自动化，并回传结果

value.en: One test shape across iOS and Android, in your language — you stop writing platform-specific automation glue.
value.zh: 同一份测试形状跨 iOS 与 Android、用你惯用的语言——不再写平台特定的自动化胶水。

sources: appium.io Quickstart (install server → install driver → client)
